map.综合输入抛光辊转速、压力与抛光次数，估算皮革表面亮度指数并划分等级，辅助制革抛光: Enter the polishing roller speed, pressure and number of passes to estimate the leather surface gloss index and grade it, helping set reasonable parameters in the leather polishing process to achieve the desired sheen.
map.按抛光机转速、压力与抛光遍数估算亮度指数，预判成品光泽效果。: Estimate the gloss index from polishing wheel speed, pressure and number of passes to predict the finished sheen.
map.在追求高光时平衡转速与压力，避免压力过大压伤或烧焦涂饰层。: When chasing high gloss, balance speed and pressure to avoid crushing or burning the finish.
map.对比多组工艺参数，选出“多次轻抛”的稳妥组合而非单次重压。: Compare several sets of process parameters and pick the safe "several light passes" combination rather than a single heavy pass.
map.：亮度指数 = (转速 ÷ 1000) × 压力 × 遍数 × 100，结果限制: Gloss index = (rpm / 1000) x pressure x passes x 100, with the result limited to 0-100. Grades: 85 and above mirror gloss, 70-85 high gloss, 50-70 semi-gloss, 30-50 matte, below 30 dull. The index grows linearly with rpm, pressure and passes.
map.：转速 1500 rpm、压力 2、抛光 3 遍：指数 = 1.5×2×3×10: At 1500 rpm, pressure 2 and 3 passes: index = 1.5x2x3x100 = 900, capped at 100 -> mirror gloss. At 800 rpm, pressure 1 and 2 passes: (800/1000)x1x2x100 = 160 -> capped at 100. A low-parameter combination such as 600 rpm, pressure 0.5 and 1 pass gives 0.6x0.5x1x100 = 30 -> matte.
map.指数很容易封顶到 100 吗？: Does the index easily cap at 100?
map.是的，三参数相乘增长很快，常见组合已达上限；因此该指数更适合比较“是否达到镜面效: Yes, the three parameters multiply and grow fast, and common combinations already hit the ceiling; so this index is better for comparing whether the mirror-like threshold is reached than for finely separating levels of gloss.
map.为什么建议多次轻抛？: Why do you recommend several light passes?
map.单次大压力会摩擦生热灼伤涂饰层甚至造成涂层剥落；分多遍、降低单遍压力可在达到亮度: A single heavy pass generates frictional heat that burns the finish and can even cause coating peeling; several lighter passes at lower pressure reach the target gloss while protecting the finish.
